_package_info.description: Canonical D&D 5e ability scores, skills, races, subraces, classes, and backgrounds from the Player's Handbook
_package_info.author: Storymaster

stat.name: Strength
stat.description: Measures physical power, athletic training, and the extent to which you can exert raw physical force.

stat.name: Dexterity
stat.description: Measures agility, reflexes, balance, and poise. Governs ranged attacks, stealth, and reaction speed.

stat.name: Constitution
stat.description: Measures health, stamina, and vital force. Determines hit points and resistance to fatigue and disease.

stat.name: Intelligence
stat.description: Measures mental acuity, accuracy of recall, and the ability to reason.

stat.name: Wisdom
stat.description: Reflects how attuned you are to the world around you, representing perceptiveness and intuition.

stat.name: Charisma
stat.description: Measures your ability to interact effectively with others — confidence, eloquence, and force of personality.

skills.name: Acrobatics
skills.description: (Dex) Keep your footing in tricky situations, perform stunts, escape grapples.

skills.name: Animal Handling
skills.description: (Wis) Calm a domesticated animal, intuit a creature's intentions, control a mount.

skills.name: Arcana
skills.description: (Int) Recall lore about spells, magic items, eldritch symbols, magical traditions, planes of existence.

skills.name: Athletics
skills.description: (Str) Climbing, jumping, swimming, and other difficult physical activities.

skills.name: Deception
skills.description: (Cha) Convincingly hide the truth, whether verbally or through actions.

skills.name: History
skills.description: (Int) Recall lore about historical events, legendary people, ancient kingdoms, recent past wars.

skills.name: Insight
skills.description: (Wis) Determine the true intentions of a creature — detect lies, predict next moves.

skills.name: Intimidation
skills.description: (Cha) Influence someone through overt threats, hostile actions, and physical violence.

skills.name: Investigation
skills.description: (Int) Look for clues, make deductions, search for hidden meaning in information.

skills.name: Medicine
skills.description: (Wis) Stabilize a dying companion or diagnose an illness.

skills.name: Nature
skills.description: (Int) Recall lore about terrain, plants and animals, weather, and natural cycles.

skills.name: Perception
skills.description: (Wis) Spot, hear, or otherwise detect the presence of something.

skills.name: Performance
skills.description: (Cha) How well you can delight an audience with music, dance, acting, storytelling.

skills.name: Persuasion
skills.description: (Cha) Influence someone with tact, social graces, or good nature.

skills.name: Religion
skills.description: (Int) Recall lore about deities, rites and prayers, religious hierarchies, holy symbols, secret cults.

skills.name: Sleight of Hand
skills.description: (Dex) Acts of legerdemain or manual trickery — pickpocketing, planting an object, concealing.

skills.name: Stealth
skills.description: (Dex) Conceal yourself from enemies, slink past guards, slip away unnoticed.

skills.name: Survival
skills.description: (Wis) Follow tracks, hunt wild game, guide your group through wastes, identify weather signs.

race.name: Human
race.description: Versatile and ambitious. In the reckoning of many sages, humans are the youngest of the common races and the most adaptable.

race.name: Elf
race.description: A magical people of otherworldly grace, living in places of ethereal beauty in ancient forests or shining spires.

race.name: Dwarf
race.description: Bold and hardy, dwarves are known as skilled warriors, miners, and workers of stone and metal.

race.name: Halfling
race.description: Small and practical, halflings prefer cozy homes, comfortable beds, and the company of friends.

race.name: Dragonborn
race.description: Walking proud, dragonborn possess draconic ancestry, with scaly hides, breath weapons, and resistance to elemental damage.

race.name: Gnome
race.description: An energetic and inventive people, gnomes brim with excitement and curiosity at every turn.

race.name: Half-Elf
race.description: Walking in two worlds but truly belonging to neither, half-elves combine human curiosity with elven sensibility.

race.name: Half-Orc
race.description: Marked by their tusks, sloping foreheads, and greenish hue, half-orcs combine human ingenuity with orcish strength.

race.name: Tiefling
race.description: Bearing the bloodline of fiends, tieflings carry horns, tails, and a whiff of brimstone — and the suspicion of strangers.

sub_race.name: High Elf
sub_race.description: Keen-minded high elves favor study of magic and the arts. Often haughty, they prize knowledge above all.

sub_race.name: Wood Elf
sub_race.description: Wood elves live in harmony with the forest. Swift, secretive, and at home in wild places.

sub_race.name: Drow (Dark Elf)
sub_race.description: Descended from an earlier subrace that ventured underground. Most are evil, but exceptions exist.

sub_race.name: Hill Dwarf
sub_race.description: Hill dwarves have keen senses, deep intuition, and remarkable resilience.

sub_race.name: Mountain Dwarf
sub_race.description: Stronger and hardier than their hill cousins, mountain dwarves train extensively for war.

sub_race.name: Lightfoot Halfling
sub_race.description: Nimble and stealthy, lightfoots are easily able to slip out of notice — even to hide behind larger creatures.

sub_race.name: Stout Halfling
sub_race.description: Stouts are hardier than average and have some resistance to poison. Said to have dwarven blood.

sub_race.name: Forest Gnome
sub_race.description: Forest gnomes have a natural knack for illusion and inherent quickness and stealth.

sub_race.name: Rock Gnome
sub_race.description: Rock gnomes have a knack for tinkering and a natural inventiveness with mechanical devices.

sub_race.name: Black Dragonborn
sub_race.description: Acid breath, resistance to acid. Descended from chromatic black dragons.

sub_race.name: Blue Dragonborn
sub_race.description: Lightning breath, resistance to lightning. Descended from chromatic blue dragons.

sub_race.name: Brass Dragonborn
sub_race.description: Fire breath, resistance to fire. Descended from metallic brass dragons.

sub_race.name: Bronze Dragonborn
sub_race.description: Lightning breath, resistance to lightning. Descended from metallic bronze dragons.

sub_race.name: Copper Dragonborn
sub_race.description: Acid breath, resistance to acid. Descended from metallic copper dragons.

sub_race.name: Gold Dragonborn
sub_race.description: Fire breath, resistance to fire. Descended from metallic gold dragons.

sub_race.name: Green Dragonborn
sub_race.description: Poison breath, resistance to poison. Descended from chromatic green dragons.

sub_race.name: Red Dragonborn
sub_race.description: Fire breath, resistance to fire. Descended from chromatic red dragons.

sub_race.name: Silver Dragonborn
sub_race.description: Cold breath, resistance to cold. Descended from metallic silver dragons.

sub_race.name: White Dragonborn
sub_race.description: Cold breath, resistance to cold. Descended from chromatic white dragons.

class.name: Barbarian
class.description: A fierce warrior of primitive background who can enter a battle rage. Hit Die d12. Primary: Strength.

class.name: Bard
class.description: An inspiring magician whose power echoes the music of creation. Hit Die d8. Primary: Charisma.

class.name: Cleric
class.description: A priestly champion who wields divine magic in service of a higher power. Hit Die d8. Primary: Wisdom.

class.name: Druid
class.description: A priest of the Old Faith, wielding the powers of nature and adopting animal forms. Hit Die d8. Primary: Wisdom.

class.name: Fighter
class.description: A master of martial combat, skilled with a variety of weapons and armor. Hit Die d10. Primary: Strength or Dexterity.

class.name: Monk
class.description: A master of martial arts, harnessing the power of the body in pursuit of physical and spiritual perfection. Hit Die d8. Primary: Dexterity & Wisdom.

class.name: Paladin
class.description: A holy warrior bound to a sacred oath. Hit Die d10. Primary: Strength & Charisma.

class.name: Ranger
class.description: A warrior who uses martial prowess and nature magic to combat threats on the edge of civilization. Hit Die d10. Primary: Dexterity & Wisdom.

class.name: Rogue
class.description: A scoundrel who uses stealth and trickery to overcome obstacles and enemies. Hit Die d8. Primary: Dexterity.

class.name: Sorcerer
class.description: A spellcaster who draws on inherent magic from a gift or bloodline. Hit Die d6. Primary: Charisma.

class.name: Warlock
class.description: A wielder of magic derived from a bargain with an extraplanar entity. Hit Die d8. Primary: Charisma.

class.name: Wizard
class.description: A scholarly magic-user capable of manipulating the structures of reality. Hit Die d6. Primary: Intelligence.

background.name: Acolyte
background.description: You spent your life in service of a temple. Skills: Insight, Religion. Feature: Shelter of the Faithful.

background.name: Charlatan
background.description: You have a way with people. You know what makes them tick, you can tease out their hearts' desires after a few minutes of conversation, and with a few leading questions you can read them like they were children's books. Skills: Deception, Sleight of Hand.

background.name: Criminal
background.description: You are an experienced criminal with a history of breaking the law. Skills: Deception, Stealth. Feature: Criminal Contact.

background.name: Entertainer
background.description: You thrive in front of an audience. You know how to entrance them, entertain them, and even inspire them. Skills: Acrobatics, Performance. Feature: By Popular Demand.

background.name: Folk Hero
background.description: You come from a humble social rank, but you are destined for so much more. Skills: Animal Handling, Survival. Feature: Rustic Hospitality.

background.name: Guild Artisan
background.description: You are a member of an artisan's guild, skilled in a particular field and closely associated with other artisans. Skills: Insight, Persuasion. Feature: Guild Membership.

background.name: Hermit
background.description: You lived in seclusion — in a sheltered community or a wilderness retreat — for a formative part of your life. Skills: Medicine, Religion. Feature: Discovery.

background.name: Noble
background.description: You understand wealth, power, and privilege. You carry a noble title, and your family owns land. Skills: History, Persuasion. Feature: Position of Privilege.

background.name: Outlander
background.description: You grew up in the wilds, far from civilization and the comforts of town and technology. Skills: Athletics, Survival. Feature: Wanderer.

background.name: Sage
background.description: You spent years learning the lore of the multiverse. Skills: Arcana, History. Feature: Researcher.

background.name: Sailor
background.description: You sailed on a seagoing vessel for years. You've weathered storms, fought sea monsters, and got along with mates. Skills: Athletics, Perception. Feature: Ship's Passage.

background.name: Soldier
background.description: War has been your life for as long as you care to remember. Skills: Athletics, Intimidation. Feature: Military Rank.

background.name: Urchin
background.description: You grew up on the streets alone, orphaned, and poor. Skills: Sleight of Hand, Stealth. Feature: City Secrets.
